canonical_full_method_seconds_per_slice.scope: NewMetric preprocessing, canonical candidate generation, label-free selection, and retrospective oracle evaluation

expanded_budget_additional_seconds_per_s.scope: Preprocessing plus additional standard-seed and fuzzy alpha-cut candidates through 30 seeds per window and 39 nested alpha levels; frozen canonical pool loading is excluded

interpretation: The two measurements have different scopes and must not be added as if obtained in one end-to-end timing pass.
